proposals.evidence: DEDR600 explicitly gives uṇ/un eat or drink across the relevant languages, Kurux ōnnā (oṇḍas) drink/eat rice, Gadaba un- (unḍ-) eat/drink, Konda uṇ- (uṭ-) drink and Kota/Toda uṇ- (uḍ-) drink. These simple or ordinary tense/nominal responses retain that consume stem and its documented alternants; source gloss distinctions and inflection are preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
